<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/chat/conversations/unread"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns the total unread count and a count keyed by conversation id for
every currently accessible `FAMILY` and `PRIVATE` conversation.
Designed for lightweight app polling (the official clients poll the
badge while the app is active). This route requires server feature
`directMessages`.
